approved_scope.title: Document viewer examples and supported file folder and GitHub opening workflows
approved_scope.description: Document viewer examples and supported file folder and GitHub opening workflows
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: Describe and link the existing approved viewer behavior and verified limitations without changing formats, runtime controls, loaders or canonical normative requirements.
acceptance_criteria: README and hosted docs link to directly openable text, both uncompressed binary kinds, self-contained composition, public repo and folder examples. A linked viewer guide explains local files/folders, GitHub locators, Preview/Cubes/Slice, camera and editing controls, downloads, binary/compact-format distinctions, limits and the two known loading gaps without claiming fixes. The generated docs bundle includes the guide; local links, exact example sources, published viewer URLs and generated text are verified, strict specs and pinned Trust pass.
